summary: One persistent OpenMP team is launched for the timed interval. Its outlined main worker 0x2230 repeats spmvRows once per requested count and compares at 0x227c; each call's spmvRows partitions rows across team threads, loops row delimiters, sums all stored nonzeros and writes each output. The compiled row helper's range endpoint is dim and its partition arithmetic assigns disjoint contiguous ranges, including remainder rows.

source_evidence.claim: CSR setup sets final delimiter to n; spmvRows computes row interval and inner nonzeros; timed parallel region loops iterations and calls row work.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clock interval calls GOMP_parallel once at 0x1a39. Persistent main worker 0x2230 repeats call to row helper 0x2100; count test/backedge are at 0x227c/0x227f. Helper partitions dim among threads using quotient/remainder (0x213c..0x215e), loops rows (0x2180..0x21cb), loops CSR entries (0x21a0..0x21bc) doing indexed vector/value multiply-add and stores each result (0x21be); empty row stores zero.
